# Cool Gray

Cool Gray is a little background Pegasus colt from the G4 television series *My Little Pony: Friendship Is Magic*. Think of him as one of Rainbow Dash’s young admirers during the friendship-journal craze, rather than a developed rival or sidekick.

- **Appearance:** Light gray coat with a faint lavender tint, brown mane and bright green eyes. See the [foal catalog](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/List_of_ponies/Foals), which records his first appearance at approximately 14:20.
- **Name and continuity:** Cool Gray appears to be a fandom/wiki identification name. His screen appearance belongs to official G4 television continuity, but no official naming, original naming event, alternate identity or merchandise name was verified.
- **Speaking status:** No individually attributed dialogue or voice actor was found. No other episode, film or comic appearance was verified.

## Important moments

1. **Rainbow Dash’s admirers — Fame and Misfortune (S7E14, August 12, 2017).** Cool Gray is cataloged among the young fans whose enthusiasm for the published friendship journal becomes overwhelming for Rainbow Dash. [Official full episode — timestamp unavailable](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9VD69mYisoU).
2. **Celebrity fatigue — Fame and Misfortune (S7E14; contextual scene).** Rainbow Dash retreats to Twilight’s castle and complains that her fans never give her privacy, illustrating the consequences of the crowd Cool Gray belongs to; no separate action or dialogue by him is established.
